vehicles_registration_uq.name: vehicles_registration_uq
vehicles_registration_uq.where: "vehicles"."registration" is not null and "vehicles"."deleted_at" is null

vehicles_service_km_le_odometer.name: vehicles_service_km_le_odometer
vehicles_service_km_le_odometer.value: "vehicles"."last_service_km" is null or "vehicles"."odometer_km" is null or "vehicles"."last_service_km" <= "vehicles"."odometer_km"

fitments_years.name: fitments_years
fitments_years.value: "fitments"."year_to" is null or "fitments"."year_from" is null or "fitments"."year_to" >= "fitments"."year_from"

shops_standing_has_reason.name: shops_standing_has_reason
shops_standing_has_reason.value: "shops"."status" not in ('paused','suspended') or (char_length("shops"."status_reason") >= 5 and "shops"."status_changed_by" is not null)

shipments_delivered_needs_proof.name: shipments_delivered_needs_proof
shipments_delivered_needs_proof.value: "shipments"."status" <> 'delivered' or ("shipments"."delivered_at" is not null and ("shipments"."delivered_via" = 'code' or ("shipments"."delivered_via" = 'override' and "shipments"."override_by" is not null and char_length("shipments"."override_reason") >= 5)))

shipments_courier_awb.name: shipments_courier_awb
shipments_courier_awb.value: "shipments"."mode" = 'own' or ("shipments"."courier" is not null and "shipments"."awb" is not null)

reviews_verified.name: reviews_verified
reviews_verified.value: "reviews"."order_id" is not null or "reviews"."service_request_id" is not null

support_tickets_owner.name: support_tickets_owner
support_tickets_owner.value: "support_tickets"."user_id" is not null or ("support_tickets"."guest_phone" is not null and "support_tickets"."access_key_hash" is not null)

coin_ledger_sign_matches_kind.name: coin_ledger_sign_matches_kind
coin_ledger_sign_matches_kind.value: ("coin_ledger"."kind" in ('earn','restore') and "coin_ledger"."delta" > 0) or ("coin_ledger"."kind" in ('redeem','expire') and "coin_ledger"."delta" < 0) or "coin_ledger"."kind" = 'adjust'

coin_ledger_redeem_has_order.name: coin_ledger_redeem_has_order
coin_ledger_redeem_has_order.value: "coin_ledger"."kind" not in ('redeem','restore') or "coin_ledger"."order_group_id" is not null
